name: Tidewell Slump
acting: Half-lidded forward gaze and off-center frown.
personality: Endures his own tides with minimal enthusiasm.
note: One wave arrived on time and the other claimed it was on the wrong coast. Tidewell declined to choose.

name: Ada Ashpuff
acting: Bashful downcast eyes and a tiny tooth.
personality: Apologizes before erupting and for some time afterward.
note: Her eruption was classed as minor because it occurred during a major apology.
voice: Dry, with a slight upward inflection.

name: Pim Noonshade
acting: Single startled eye and a tiny O.
personality: Likes to have something official to hide behind.
note: He claimed the disc had no back. I spent the afternoon proving him half right.
call: Could you look away for a minute?

name: Tess Sheerair
acting: One eye shut, other on the peel, with a relieved smile.
personality: Gets irritable when the air fits too tightly.
note: She peeled the weather off in one piece. Underneath it was pleasantly local.

name: Bram Stoneear
props: split rock with teal inner seam
acting: Eyes up and jaw tightly braced.
personality: Takes rocks more seriously once they start talking.
note: The geode asked for a private word. Bram heard enough to wish it had stayed a mineral.

name: Wally Northgone
acting: Eyes toward the compass and a wide shout.
personality: Has trouble keeping his bearings on speaking terms.
note: North left abruptly. West said this had been building for years.
